title: Read-only checkpoint continuation and final adjudication of C021 WP01
objective: Freeze the exact Phase1275 partial-ledger hashes, run only the five remaining preregistered model keys, and produce the one complete 27-model C021 adjudication.
recovery_rules: Phase1275 qualification keys must equal the first 22 keys of the original frozen order.
Phase1275 measured keys must equal the behavior-qualified subset of those 22 keys.
Only the remaining five original keys may be trained.
All prior failures remain in the denominator and no seed is replaced.
hard_stops: Any partial-ledger hash or prefix-order mismatch denies continuation.
No camera score is read until all 27 qualification records exist.
The original Phase1274 semantic digest and material bytes must remain unchanged.
Failure closes C021 synthetic local-isomorphism search.
